_note: Open-items ledger. Papers confirmed MISSED by the tracker and then keyword-fixed, but not yet published in any report. A keyword fix is forward-looking only: it changes what future runs can retrieve, it does NOT carry the specific paper into a report, and the moving harvest window immediately steps past the paper's posting date. This ledger is the carry-forward guarantee. DRAIN IT AT THE START OF EVERY RUN: fetch each status="open" item's metadata, score it with the current scorer, include it if it passes Quality Standards, then set status="resolved" and reported=<YYYY-MM-DD>. If it fails the relevance bar, set status="dropped" with a reason. See prompts/daily-paper-tracker.md -> 'Open-items ledger'.

items.title: Disrupted hippocampal replay is associated with reduced offline map stabilization in an Alzheimer's mouse model
items.authors: Shipley, S.; Abrate, M. P.; Hayman, R.; Chan, D.; Barry, C.
items.note: Recycling trap: UCL press coverage in October 2026, but Curr Biol 36(4):859-871.e5, published January 2026 (PMID 41616770). Was never reported. Replay RATE is unchanged in App NL-G-F mice but replay QUALITY is degraded (disrupted cell recruitment, reduced co-firing structure), and that degradation predicts failure of offline place-cell stabilization. Directly on-pillar for Schema-Episodic (hippocampal replay / consolidation).

items.title: Inhibitory tone in the dentate gyrus dynamically prioritizes memory flexibility or stability by tuning a sensitivity-consistency continuum
items.authors: Perez-Montoyo, E.; Carames, J. M.; Garcia-Hernandez, R.; Peralta-Canadas, M.; Canals, S.; Marcos, E.
items.note: Recycling trap: October 2026 news coverage, published 2026-08-18 (PLoS Biol 24(8):e3003956). Pharmacogenetics + behaviour + computational model: reducing DG inhibition during encoding of overlapping experiences enhances later discrimination but increases interference susceptibility under high memory load; increasing inhibition stabilizes but blurs. A pattern-separation/completion trade-off set by inhibitory tone - on-pillar for Schema-Episodic.
